subject: Supplier credentialing: Orbitix COI endorsement, subcontractor disclosure, and PO routing
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@orbitixlabs.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orbitix onboarding docs (COI + W9) / next steps for PO

Hi Soojin —

Thanks again for the quick intro call this morning. Attached are our current COI and a completed W-9 to start the vendor setup. A few quick notes:

- COI: current policy limits are $2M GL, $5M aggregate.
- We do use a small set of subcontractors for on-site hardware deliveries (listed separately in the subcontractor CSV).

Can you confirm whether Redwood needs the insurer to issue an endorsement naming Redwood Inference as Additional Insured and whether a waiver of subrogation is required? Also confirm the certificate holder address you prefer so we can send this to our broker.

We'd like to get a PO in place so Orbitix can schedule the initial pilot gear shipment. If there's a procurement portal link or form you prefer, send it over and we'll complete it today.

Attachements: Orbitix_COI.pdf, Orbitix_W9.pdf, subcontractor_list.csv

Thanks —
Elena Park
Head of Operations, Orbitix Labs
elena@orbitixlabs.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

On attachments: the COI is the certificate only; endorsement language will come from our broker if required.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@orbitixlabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 18:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orbitix onboarding docs (COI + W9) / next steps for PO

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and attachments. A few procurement items so we can keep the activation moving:

1) Certificate holder / remit address (please use on the COI):
   Redwood Inference, Inc.
   123 Market St, 5th Floor
   San Francisco, CA 94105

2) Endorsement: Redwood requires Additional Insured endorsement on the General Liability policy with the following exact language in the endorsement section (or equivalent ACORD endorsement):
   "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors and employees are named as Additional Insured for both ongoing and products-completed operations, with a primary and noncontributory endorsement where permitted by law."

3) Waiver of subrogation: we accept if the insurer is willing to include it on a primary basis.

4) Subcontractors: please confirm whether subcontractors are insured to the same minimums and provide a brief list (we received the CSV but need confirmation that coverage applies to them).

5) Invoicing / PO routing: we use a vendor portal for PO creation. Please fill the vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (attached) with payment remittance details and preferred invoice email; procurement will issue a conditional PO for pilot shipments once we have the onboarding form and W9, then convert to a standard PO after endorsement is finalized.

If you can get your broker to provide the endorsement page (endorsement_page.pdf) and updated COI within 7 business days that will be ideal. If there are timing constraints, comment below so we can evaluate conditional PO terms.

Thanks — I looped Vivek (vendor ops) to help with logistics once the PO is issued.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Strategic Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@orbitixlabs.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orbitix onboarding docs (COI + W9) / next steps for PO

Elena —

Quick procurement note on PO terms and next steps from our side:

- Standard payment: Net30 from invoice receipt unless otherwise negotiated.
- PO approvals: Pilot PO (<= $10k) can be issued by procurement; larger commitments require sourcing + finance sign-off.
- Tax ID / remit: please confirm the legal entity and EIN on the onboarding form.

Portal links:
- Vendor portal activation: https://redwood.app/vendor-portal/activate?record=ORB-9843
- DocuSign (for any vendor agreement) will be shared from procurement: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/XYZ-ORB-9843

On endorsements: to avoid back-and-forth with brokers we typically accept a certificate plus an ACORD endorsement PDF that shows the Additional Insured language plus the insurer's stamp. If the broker needs sample text, use the language Soojin provided.

If you anticipate a >$10k order in the first month let us know so we can expedite approvals.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Orbitix onboarding docs (COI + W9) / next steps for PO

Elena —

Thank you for the clarity and the broker confirmation. Procurement will proceed with a conditional pilot PO for $4,200 to allow the first shipment to schedule. A few conditions we need to be clear on:

- The conditional PO will explicitly state that final payment is contingent on receipt of insurer-signed Additional Insured endorsement and updated COI within 10 business days of PO issuance.
- If the endorsement is not received within 10 business days, Redwood reserves the right to suspend future shipments and/or withhold final payment until coverage is confirmed.
- Subcontractors: please confirm in writing (reply-all) that your subcontractors listed in subcontractor_list.csv are covered by the same GL limits and Additional Insured endorsement scope.

Vivek — once PO is issued I will pass the logistics details to you for scheduling. Marcus — please review the conditional PO language below and flag any concerns from legal.

Next steps for Orbitix:
1) Confirm subcontractor coverage reply (reply-all).
2) Provide insurer-signed endorsement + updated COI within 10 business days.
3) Procurement to issue conditional PO and send vendor portal invite (Orbitix to accept).

I'll start the PO in the portal and send it over as soon as the completed vendor_onboarding_form is submitted.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Strategic Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
